blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `calculateShippingOptionsPrices` method. This belongs to the Fulfillment Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method calculates the prices for one or more shipping options.

types.description: The shipping options data to calculate the prices for.

Weither or not a sub workflow cancellation is being triggered from a parent step.
If true, the parent step will not be triggered by the sub workflow.

children.name: is_calculated_price_tax_inclusive
children.description:
Whether the calculated price includes taxes. If enabled, Medusa will
infer the taxes from the calculated price. If false, Medusa will
add taxes to the calculated price.
